name: Zor Fit
summary: A gym front desk: members and plans, live check-in floor, fees due, trainers and revenue in PKR
about: A black and neon front desk for a gym with gents and ladies timings, in PKR. It keeps members with their plan and expiry, checks people in and out while a live floor shows who is inside, chases fees that are due, assigns clients to trainers and charts monthly revenue. Good for a neighbourhood gym, a fitness studio or a sports club.
how: The Inside now count ticks live as people walk in and out every few seconds.
Open Check-in and type a name, phone or ZF number. Press Enter or Check in and the member pops onto the gym floor; expired members are stopped with a Collect fee button.
Drag a person on the floor to another zone, or tap them to check out.
On Fees, send reminders or press Renew to collect a plan: the new expiry is worked out for you.
On Trainers, drag a client card from one coach to another, or use the move button.
Revenue shows memberships, personal training and admissions; switch 7D, 30D or 12M and the line reshapes.
